---
name: Bug report
about: Something didn't work as it should
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**What happened?**
A clear description of what went wrong.

**What did you expect?**
What should have happened instead.

**Your language**
Which language were you using (e.g., Tamil, Hindi, Bhojpuri)? If you can,
include what you said — written in your script is perfect.

**Your phone (if known)**
Model and RAM if you know them, e.g., "Redmi 9A, 2GB". Vaani targets
low-end phones, so this matters to us.

**Was the phone offline?**
Yes / No / Not sure — offline bugs are our top priority.

**Anything else?**
Screenshots help. So does anything you noticed just before the problem.
